nodes.question: What could be a potential indicator for estimating high-cycle thermal fatigue according to the paragraph?
nodes.answer: The degree of temperature fluctuation can serve as a qualitative indicator for estimating high-cycle thermal fatigue.
nodes.paragraph: As previously stated, engineers and researchers are becoming increasingly concerned with the mixing behaviours and temperature uctuations in the T-section because they can cause thermal fatigue and damage. Hence,a potential correlation could exist between uctuations intemperature and thermal fatigue. Furthermore, the degree of uctuation of temperature can serve as a qualitative indi- cator for estimating high-cycle thermal fatigue. Numerousresearchers have utilized the Power Spectral Density and Root Mean Square to quantify the amplitude and frequency of the uctuation, respectively, when assessing thermalfatigue and temperature uctuations in T-sections [ 6,13]. Based on the aforementioned mechanism and research approach, numerous researchers [ 14 16] reported that cram- ming porous medium in the interfacial zone was helpful inthe reduction of thermal uctuations in the T-section. The eld of uid solid coupling mechanics has experienced signi cant advancements in recent years. Researchers havebecome increasingly intrigued by the quantitative correlation that exists between temperature uctuations and high-cycle thermal fatigue [ 16 18]. nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How is the expiration date of products monitored in the classification process?
nodes.answer: The expiration date of products is monitored using the Average Remaining Life (ARL) indicator, which helps in screening the status of the product concerning its expiry date.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Responsible purchasing habits|Longevity assessment_qna_002
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why is the variability of annual rankings important in sustainability assessments?
nodes.answer: The variability of annual rankings is crucial in sustainability assessments as it allows for tracking progress or regression over time. This information provides a deeper understanding of how alternatives are evolving and performing in relation to each other.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Responsible purchasing habits|Longevity assessment_qna_003
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the significance of Temporal PROMETHEUS II in sustainability assessment?
nodes.answer: Temporal PROMETHEUS II is significant in sustainability assessment as it provides a new multi-criteria temporal method that allows for monitoring goal achievement over time, offering a comprehensive view of performance dynamics.

nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: What factors influence consumer expectations regarding the longevity of clothing?
nodes.answer: Consumer expectations regarding clothing longevity can be influenced by factors such as brand reputation, material quality, price point, and personal care habits.
